summary: Reviewed the static capabilities declaration and dependency/process boundary; Empirical availability needs no Empirical binary, Node package, network fetch, MCP server, or skill.
Reviewed schema validation, deterministic snapshot/revision construction, sorted capabilities, preview serialization, diagnostics bound, and explicit route assertions for every required field.
Reviewed shared delta parsing and stable global RQ/AC numbering; capability, operation, requirement, and scenario provenance are retained for ADDED, MODIFIED, and REMOVED blocks.
Reviewed design normalization and conservative serial task extraction; decisions, evidence, events, locks, and volatile state bodies are deliberately excluded from imported output.
Reviewed create ordering and route integration: revision revalidation precedes ID creation, workspace planning/materialization, provider attempts, approvals, runs, and aggregate persistence.
Reviewed exact path grammar, anchored no-follow handles, double snapshots, identity rebound, shape/schema/text checks, file/count/byte bounds, and adversarial tests; unsafe input fails closed.

Reviewed the closed TypeScript union, source card and capability gate, canonical path payload, immutable preview rendering, diagnostic output, and revision-bound create request against component and browser evidence.
Reviewed documentation, golden policy, exact upstream pin, provenance hashes, and bundled MIT license; wording is explicitly local artifact-intake and disclaims runtime/export compatibility.
Reviewed the full diff and passing regression gates; provider isolation, approval/evidence digests, existing sources, browser evidence, and Deliver-only side effects are unchanged.
